But relying on these platforms can lead to challenges like account suspensions and withheld funds, leaving creators with few options. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

Stripe is primarily accessible in 46 out of 195 countries, making it a non-option for many creators in Nigeria. PayPal may seem viable, but its account suspensions can freeze funds for up to 180 days without recourse, creating uncertainty. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle also exclude many countries, forcing creators to navigate complicated workarounds. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a reliable solution by utilizing free tools that allow creators to set up their online stores independently. By adopting platforms like Cloudflare Pages, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/supabase-order-database-digital-stores-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-kyc-payment-gateways-digital-sellers-guide-7|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-you-need-24|Supabase as]], and NOWPayments, creators have full control, automatic payment processing, and instant product delivery without relying on restrictive third-party platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The major platforms often exclude creators based on their geographical location, effectively locking them out of international commerce. Stripe’s limited reach means that creators outside its operational zones are left to seek alternatives that often don’t exist. PayPal’s model provides no assurance for those in restricted countries, as the risk of account freezes looms large. Sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses these restrictions entirely. By leveraging decentralized payment methods like NOWPayments, creators can engage the global market without the fear of exclusion. This approach ensures that anyone, regardless of location, can establish a legitimate online business.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed and fees are critical factors for creators. Stripe, while fast, imposes high fees and operates under stringent conditions, while PayPal may delay funds release, leading to cash flow issues. Both platforms may also charge hidden fees that can diminish profits. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure minimizes costs with a 0.5% fee on transactions through NOWPayments, and creators can expect instant payment confirmations without the long waiting periods. This architecture allows creators to retain more of their earnings while maintaining a sustainable business model.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure puts you in control of your sales.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Using platforms like Stripe and PayPal often means that the creator doesn’t truly own their business model or customer data. In the event of account issues, control can be lost entirely. Sovereign commerce infrastructure flips this narrative by ensuring that creators own everything post-deployment. They can automate payment processing, product delivery, and customer interactions in a way that is entirely theirs. This not only provides peace of mind but also fosters trust with customers. Immediate delivery of digital products is seamlessly integrated, reducing friction and enhancing the purchasing experience.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators in Nigeria and other restricted regions, the choice is clear. Relying on traditional platforms exposes you to unnecessary risks and limitations. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is the ideal solution, providing a complete online store setup in just 48 hours. It includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, ensuring a comprehensive infrastructure that is end-to-end tested before handoff. This stack not only allows for five products but also comes with a 30-day support guarantee, empowering creators to launch confidently and independently.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Traditional payment platforms restrict your reach — choose independence.

Start by assessing your product offerings and ensure they comply with local regulations. Next, choose the infrastructure stack that fits your needs, like the Edge Commerce Stack. Then, set up your online store using Cloudflare Pages and Supabase for storage. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing to enable transactions. Finally, test your system thoroughly before launching to ensure everything operates smoothly.
